**Updates you can't get stuck on.** Settings → App now has a **Restart and update** button when an update is ready, plus a backup: **Run the installer yourself** opens the installer with its normal window. If an update ever fails, the app shows what went wrong.

**Desktop icon fix.** After updating, Windows sometimes kept showing an old app icon on the desktop shortcut. The app now refreshes Windows' icon cache the first time a new version starts.

If your copy keeps failing to update, download `EZ VoiceChat_0.1.4_x64-setup.exe` below and run it once.
